record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not
independent evidence. Return exactly one valid JSON object and do not reveal

claims.claim: Direct human absolute oral bioavailability measurements for structurally related aryloxypropanolamine beta-blockers are all at or above 27% at baseline: celiprolol 30–70%, diacetolol 30–43%, betaxolol 70–90%, practolol ~100%, pamatolol 64.9–150.5%, almokalant ~50%, and CP-331,684 27%. This class-level evidence supports F ≥ 20% for the query's beta-blocker scaffold.

L5 human interaction records show that P-gp inhibition with itraconazole increases plasma celiprolol and nadolol, establishing clinically relevant gut-wall P-gp efflux for close structural analogues. Because rifampin is a P-gp inducer, this supports a direction of reduced oral absorption under rifampin, but no record quantifies the reduction or reports F < 20% for the query.
